meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 它会检测你已有的 OpenClaw 安装，读出身份、频道凭证、定时任务等配置，逐项和你确认每样东西放进 NanoClaw v2 的位置后再写入，并记录迁移进度。
howto.when: 当你说出 “migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration” 等请求，或想把 OpenClaw 迁到 NanoClaw v2 时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 会先扫描并汇总你的 OpenClaw 安装

say.text: 我的 OpenClaw 装在自定义目录，路径不是默认的
把 OpenClaw 的每日记忆文件一起带过来
say.note: 会让你选复制、合并还是跳过

howto.what_en: It detects an existing OpenClaw install, reads identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks and other config, then discusses each item with you to decide what moves into NanoClaw v2 and where. Nothing is applied until you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "migrate from openclaw" or "openclaw migration", or when you want to move an OpenClaw setup into NanoClaw v2.

say_en.text: Migrate me from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: Scans and summarizes your OpenClaw install first

say_en.text: My OpenClaw lives in a custom directory
Bring over my OpenClaw daily memory files
say_en.note: You choose copy, consolidate, or skip
